notes.title: DEFLECTION Full Game OUT NOW
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

You can now buy Deflection now on Steam!
Me and a friend have worked so hard on this game, and if you enjoy it, please leave a review on Steam, it helps SO MUCH with visibility.

[previewyoutube=5jO75WAYdmE;full][/previewyoutube]

Here is a list of features present in the full game:
- Local and Online Multiplayer and Singleplayer vs AI (easy and hard difficulty).
- Level Editor/Creator (play maps you create in Multiplayer & Singleplayer)
- Timed Mode/Competitive Mode (Multiplayer only)
- Tutorial mode which goes through rules and tactics.
- Many different pieces with advantages, downsides, abilities and more.
- A ton of scenarios/maps designed to challenge you, each having unique pieces only available in them.
- Replay Mode (see what happened during the game, go through all the moves)
- And more!

Buy it here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1517240/LASER_CHESS_Deflection/

Have an awesome day,
Philippe
